Name: Omega's revision of Shiko (alternate portraits and sprites)
Author: OmegaFallon
Description:
While looking for potential mods, I found FluffyCakeChan's alternate portraits for Shiko. I really liked them, really not even for the sexual aspect, I just think they're very well made and look really pretty. I really hate the BZZG overworld sprites (seriously, the boobs are so comically big in those sprites it's not even sexy, it's just funny) so I decided to instead simply edit the original Shiko sprites, covering her left eye and changing her shirt to reflect the new portraits. I also changed her bikini to have a bit less... flimsiness, I suppose, and her sleep shirt is now opaque.

I made this mod for myself first and foremost, so if nobody really cares for it, that's fine, I just figured I'd put it out there. Some things to note: even though she has a beach portrait, I did not make a beach overworld sprite; I am not an artist. This mod is intended to be placed on top of FluffyCakeChan's version of BZZG and the original Shiko, ofc.

Enjoy!
